scope: Actual native images inspected by script author; no owner preference inferred.

items.observation: Open left crescent palm and unloaded right circle; ram and horn bell present. Close muzzle proximity is less cautious than intended.
Strong actual airborne displacement from ram mouth gust, both boots off ground and right circle unlit. The failure has visible physical consequence.
Right boot/left gauntlet landing and chipped left edge are visible; right uncharged.
Ram wince, moving bell and Tavi concern communicate sound sensitivity.
Detached cloth offered, plain cream belt, horn bell retained; negotiation has a legible practical solution.
Bell now on peg, cloth padding and two grounded boots; right circle contains charge.
Small puff actually comes from LEFT hand while previous charge was RIGHT. Bell reaction and relaxed ram make gentle test readable, but anatomical rule transfer fails.
Mara holds padded bell; low ram permits mounting. Chip continuity weak.
Tavi mounts broad bare ram back behind horns; Mara assists boot. No harness or shafts.
Tavi seated astride ram, right circle handshake with Mara, warm partnership payoff.
Tavi moves to caravan bench and ram becomes harnessed draft animal: this contradicts the negotiated independent ride. Narrow structural repair proposed separately.
